description:
CopyCharm is a context workbench for saving and reusing prompts, notes, favorite clips, and curated working context.

With this ChatGPT integration, existing CopyCharm users can access selected CopyCharm items directly within ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying and pasting the same background information, project notes, or templates into each chat, users can ask ChatGPT to find and retrieve the exact context they need.

This integration only accesses items that have been intentionally made available for AI Access in CopyCharm. It does not provide ChatGPT with access to a user's broader workspace or general clipboard history.
